description: Lowe's Companies, Inc. and its subsidiaries, a Fortune 100 company, is the world's second largest home improvement retailer, and as of January 30, 2026 it operated 1,759 home improvement stores and outlets in the United States, representing approximately 196 million square feet of retail selling space, and in addition operated over 540 branch locations in the United States and Canada, which include its current year acquisitions of Foundation Building Materials and Artisan Design Group. Lowe's was founded in 1921 with the opening of its first hardware store in North Wilkesboro, North Carolina, was incorporated in North Carolina in 1952 and has been publicly held since 1961, and its common stock is listed on the New York Stock Exchange under the ticker symbol LOW. It operates as an omnichannel retailer focused on serving individual homeowners and renters completing a wide array of projects along the spectrum of DIY and do-it-for-me, as well as small to medium sized Pro customers including tradespeople, repair and remodelers and property managers.
